div.head: Excom VII 3
div.ab: sin hi amansumede ⁊ geniðrode þa men, þe þas stale gefremoden ⁊ þe þærto geþwærdon ⁊ þe þær ænig dæl habbað oððe hæfdon oððe get anbidiað to habbanne;
seien sie excommunicirt und verdammt die Menschen, welche diesen Diebstahl vollführten und die dazu beistimmten und die daran irgend einen Antheil haben oder hatten oder noch zu erhalten erwarten;
may they be excommunicated and damned, the people who committed this theft and who consented to it and who have or had any share in it or still expect to receive one;
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text and German translation transcribed from Gesetze I p. 438 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
